description: A query word that names a kind of object must not leave the objects of that kind hidden behind far objects that merely carry the word in their name. Berlin centre, phrases 'parkplatz' and 'furt' as a German user types them (phrasesLang de makes them POI categories, as in the app). The extract holds the car parks within 1 km, 19 car parks named '... Parkplatz' within 8 km, and 459 streets, charging stations, info boards and the like named '... Parkplatz' up to 250 km away; 7 fords within 3 km, the 24 real hamlets called 'Furt' 470-800 km away in Bavaria, Austria and Switzerland, and 397 streets and brooks named '... Furt' up to 250 km away. Without namedByKind every car park is a subordinate node - a two-part answer - and sinks under all the far Parkplatz-named streets (rank 2000 on the real map); without queryIsKind the exact name of a far hamlet cancels the distance dimming and the hamlets stand above the fords 1.3 km off.
